title: Agents per AIP, as many as it needs
quote: It should never be 20 to 50 agents per AIP. Several AIPs can and should run with several agents each, but that generic rule is wrong.
means: There is no fixed number of agents. Each AIP starts the agents its work needs; several AIPs can run at once, each with its own agents. The 20 to 50 threads came from the legacy CLAUDE.md and do not apply in theOS.

reflection.checked: every decision before d-ae58 that held
